QuestInfo.name: Jewel of the Desert
QuestInfo.0: What did #p9074200# have to go through to so perfectly capture the summer in Ariant? Go into the picture and ask him.
QuestInfo.1: #p9074200# came to Ariant because he'd heard how beautiful #p9074201# is. Go draw a sketch of her so that he can prepare himself before he begins his portrait.
QuestInfo.2: You gave #p9074200# your portrait of the queen.

0.0: Another rumor hunter, eh? Well you're not gonna beat ME to the blindingly ravishing Queen of Ariant, #p9074201#. I got here first! Soon, my eyeballs will pop like boiled grapes at the first glimpse of her regal beauty!
0.1: However, I suppose I could let you go first if I were properly motivated. Besides, it wouldn't do for an artiste like myself to be blinded in the middle of becoming an art juggernaut!
0.2: Maybe YOU should go paint a portrait of the queen. Don't worry, even your clumsy, chimpanzee-level brushwork should be able to capture her essence.

yes.0: Excellent! I'll be here with a nice pair of sunglasses and a cane for when you come tumbling back down the stairs!

no.0: I thought you were prepared to achieve greatness. Oh well, eyeballs, it was nice knowing you...

item.0: What are you waiting for? Do you want to see forever?!
